question: The CEO insisted that the report ______ revised immediately.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查虚拟语气在宾语从句中的用法，特别是动词insist后接that从句时的语法结构。句子主干为"The CEO insisted that..."，其中insist是一个表示"坚持要求"的动词。根据英语语法规则，当insist表示"坚持要求(某事被做)"时，其后的that从句应使用虚拟语气，结构为:(should)+动词原形。此外，由于report与revise之间是被动关系(报告被修改)，因此动词应使用被动语态。

question: Not only ______ late, but he also forgot the documents.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查倒装句结构，特别是“Not only...but also...”引导的并列句中，当Not only位于句首时，主句需使用部分倒装(即助动词/情态动词提前)。句子开头为Not only，说明这是一个以否定副词短语开头的句子，按照英语语法规则，此时主句需要进行部分倒装。此外，后半句“but he also forgot the documents”使用了一般过去时(forgot)，因此前半句也应保持时态一致，使用一般过去时。

question: ______ the heavy rain, the event went on as planned.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查介词与从属连词在表达"让步"或"原因"关系时的正确用法，重点在于区分despite/in spite of (介词短语)与although(从属连词)以及because of(表示原因的介词短语)的语法结构和语义功能。主句是"the event went on as planned"，前面是一个表示与主句逻辑关系的状语成分。根据句意，“尽管下着大雨，活动仍按计划进行”，此处应表达"让步"关系，即"虽然有大雨，但活动照常进行”。

question: Do you still remember the day ______ we spent together last month?
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查定语从句中关系词的选择。重点在于判断先行词的性质(是表示时间、地点、人还是物)，以及关系词在从句中所作的成分(主语、宾语、状语等)。句子主干为: "Do you still remember the day...",其中 the day 是先行词,后面跟个定语从句 'we spent together last month'。需要选择一个合适的关系词来引导这个定语从句。关键在于分析从句"we spent together last month"的结构:主语:we;谓语:spent;宾语动词 spend 是及物动词，通常说 spend time/money,因此这里 the day 实际上是 spend 的宾语，即"we spent the day together"。因此，定语从句中缺少的是宾语，且该宾语指代的是 the day(表示一段时间，但在此处被当作"物"来使用)。

question: When I first came here, they ______ this bridge yet.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查的是过去完成时的用法，特别是与yet连用时在特定时间参照点之前的动作是否完成。关键在于理解主句动作(came here)和从句动作(build the bridge)之间的时间先后关系。“When I first came here”表示一个明确的过去时间点。yet通常用于否定句或疑问句中，表示"到目前为止还没有..."。因此，空格处应表达"在我第一次来到这里的时候，他们还没有建这座桥”，即:建桥的动作发生在“我来”之前尚未完成。这种"过去的过去"需要用过去完成时(had+过去分词)，且是否定形式。

question: There's plenty of time. You ______ hurry.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查情态动词的用法，特别是表示"必要性"或"禁止"的情态动词在具体语境中的正确选择。重点在于理解句意以及各情态动词(don't, needn't, mustn't, haven't)在表达"不必"、"禁止"、"没有"等含义时的语法功能和语义差异。前半句"There's plenty of time.”(时间很充裕)表明说话人认为没有必要着急。因此，后半句应表达"你不必着急"的意思。需要选择一个能准确表达"不必"这一含义的情态动词或结构。

question: Physics ______ with matter and motion.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查主谓一致以及动词时态的正确使用。关键在于识别主语的单复数形式，并据此选择与之匹配的谓语动词形式。句子主语是Physics(物理学)。虽然以-s结尾，看似复数，但Physics在此处是一门学科名称，属于不可数名词，作单数使用。因此，谓语动词应使用第三人称单数形式。句子表达的是一般事实或普遍真理(物理学研究物质与运动)，应使用一般现在时。

question: ______ reaching the village, we were warmly welcomed by the villagers.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查介词与动名词搭配构成时间状语的用法，特别是"on+动名词”结构表示"一...就..."的固定搭配。句子主干为'we were warmly welcomed by the villagers",前半部分"reaching the village"作时间状语,表示"一到达村庄,我们就受到了村民的热情欢迎"。此处需要一个能与动名词reaching搭配、表达"在...之时"或"一...就..."含义的介词。

question: He is by far ______ student in class.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查形容词最高级的用法，特别是by far这一强调结构与形容词比较级或最高级的搭配规则，以及定冠词the在最高级中的必要性。句意为"他是班上毫无疑问最...的学生。"空格后是可数名词单数student，且范围限定为in class (在班上)，这是一个明确的比较范围通常用于最高级结构。此外，by far常用于加强语气，既可以修饰比较级，也可以修饰最高级，但当修饰最高级时，必须使用"the+最高级"。

question: Of the two dictionaries, I'd like to choose ______ one.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查形容词比较级的用法，特别是“the+比较级"结构在特指两者中"更...的一个"时的正确使用。同时涉及定冠词the在比较结构中的必要性。句意为:“在这两本词典中，我想选较便宜的那本。"关键词是"of the two dictionaries(在两本词典之中)，这明确表示是在两者之间进行比较，因此应使用比较级，而非原级或最高级。此外，在特指"两者中较...的那个"时，英语习惯上需加定冠词the。

question: What will you do if it ______ tomorrow?
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查的是条件状语从句中时态的正确使用，特别是if引导的真实条件句（第一类条件句）中的主从句时态搭配规则。句子主句为"What will you do...", 使用了一般将来时(will + 动词原形)，表示对将来情况的提问。从句为"if it ______ tomorrow"，是对将来可能发生的情况的假设。在英语中，当主句使用一般将来时，由if引导的真实条件状语从句中通常使用一般现在时表示将来，这被称为“主将从现”原则。

question: He ______ at the meeting, but a heart attack struck him.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查的是英语中表示“过去将来”或“未实现的意图/计划”的时态用法，特别是与过去某个时间点相关的将来动作（但该动作因某种原因未能发生）。重点涉及过去进行时表将来(was/were going to do)与一般过去时、will、be going to等结构在语境中的区别。句子后半部分"but a heart attack struck him"表明“他突发心脏病”，这是一个发生在过去的事件，且导致前半句的动作未能实现。因此，前半句应表达“他本来打算在会上发言”但因心脏病而未能发言。这种“过去打算做某事但未做成”的含义，通常用“was/were going to + 动词原形”来表达。

question: The traffic in our city is already good and it ______ even better.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查动词时态的正确使用，特别是现在进行时与一般现在时、一般过去时及过去完成时之间的区别。关键在于理解语境中 already good 和 even better 所体现的时间关系和动作发展趋势。句子前半部分"The traffic in our city is already good"使用了一般现在时，说明当前交通状况良好。后半句"and it ______ even better"应表达的是这种良好状况正在进一步改善，强调一种“正在发生的变化”或“持续发展的趋势”。因此，需要选择一个能体现“当前正在变好”的时态。

question: How I wish every family ______ a large house with a beautiful garden!
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查虚拟语气的用法，特别是 wish 后接宾语从句时对现在或将来情况的虚拟表达。句子开头为 How I wish...，表示一种强烈的愿望。根据英语语法规则，wish 后的宾语从句若表示与现在事实相反的愿望，应使用一般过去时（be 动词通常用 were）；若表示与过去事实相反，则用过去完成时；若表示对将来的不太可能实现的愿望，可用 would/could + 动词原形。本句中，"every family ______ a large house with a beautiful garden" 表达的是说话人希望每个家庭“现在”拥有大房子和花园，但现实中并非如此，因此是对现在情况的虚拟，应使用一般过去时。

question: The teacher told us ______ talk during the exam.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查的是英语中“动词不定式的否定形式”以及宾语从句或间接引语中动词的正确结构。核心在于掌握 “tell someone (not) to do something” 这一固定搭配的用法。句子主干为 "The teacher told us ______ talk during the exam."，其中 told us 后面需要接一个宾语补足语，说明老师告诉我们的内容。根据英语习惯，动词 tell 后常接带 to 的不定式作宾语补足语，即 "tell someone to do something" 或 "tell someone not to do something"。因此，此处应使用不定式的否定形式。

question: I don't think we'll be able to ______ any travel any more.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查动词辨析及动词与上下文语境的搭配能力，重点在于理解各选项动词的基本含义及其在“经济能力”或“可行性”语境中的适用性。句意为：“我认为我们再也无法______任何旅行了。”空格后接的是 any travel，表示“任何形式的旅行”。结合前半句 "I don't think we'll be able..."（我不认为我们还能......），暗示一种否定的可能性，通常与经济能力、时间、机会等限制有关。此处最可能表达的是“负担不起旅行”的意思。

question: His mother didn't ______ him to watch TV before he finished his homework.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查动词的语义辨析及动词后接宾语和不定式（或宾语补足语）的用法，尤其关注表示“允许”或“禁止”意义的动词在句中的搭配与语境适配性。主语是 His mother，谓语部分缺失一个动词，宾语是 him，后面接 to watch TV。整个句子表达的意思是“在他完成作业之前，他妈妈不______他看电视。”根据常识和语境，此处应填入一个表示“允许”的动词，且该动词需能接“宾语 + to do”结构。

question: It is not very suitable to sing such a song on this formal ______.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查名词辨析，重点在于区分 case、occasion、situation 和 condition 在具体语境中的适用性，尤其是与“正式场合”相关的表达搭配。句子为："It is not very suitable to sing such a song on this formal ______." 句意是：“在这样一个正式的______上唱这样的歌不太合适。”空格前有形容词 formal（正式的），说明此处需要一个能与“正式”搭配、表示特定时间或场合的名词。需要选出一个最符合英语习惯用法的词。

question: Some of the stamps belong to me, while the rest are ______.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查物主代词的正确使用，特别是名词性物主代词（如 his, hers, theirs 等）与形容词性物主代词（如 his, her, their 等）的区别，以及在句子中作表语时的语法结构。前半句说明“一些邮票属于我”，后半句用 while 引导对比，意为“其余的（邮票）是______的”。空格处需要填入能表示“属于他和她”的正确物主代词形式，并且在句中作表语（即跟在系动词 are 后面）。在英语中，当我们要表达“某物属于某人”且省略名词时（如“这些邮票是他的”），应使用名词性物主代词（如 mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs）。这类代词本身相当于“形容词性物主代词 + 名词”，可独立作主语、宾语或表语。

question: There was no ______ in continuing. The race was over for her.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查固定搭配与语境中名词的恰当使用，重点在于理解 "there is no ______ in doing something" 这一常见英语表达结构中应填入哪个名词最符合习惯用法和句意。前半句表示“继续下去没有______”，后半句说明“比赛对她来说已经结束了”，暗示继续下去毫无意义或没有必要。因此，空格处应填入一个能表达“意义、必要性”含义的名词，并且能与 "there is no...in doing..." 结构自然搭配。

question: Because of her behaviour she now has ______ friends than before.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查的是形容词比较级的用法，特别是可数名词与不可数名词在比较结构中的区别，以及 few/little 与其比较级 fewer/less 的正确使用。问题关键词是 friends，这是一个可数名词的复数形式；句中还出现了 than，表明此处需要使用比较级。因此，空格处应填入一个修饰可数名词复数的比较级形容词。

question: Our car ______ on our way to the village.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查的是英语中由 break 构成的常见短语动词的辨析，重点在于理解各短语在具体语境中的含义和用法。句子描述的是在去村庄的路上发生的一件事，主语是 our car（我们的车），因此空格处应填入一个表示“汽车出故障”或类似含义的短语动词。需要从四个选项中选出最符合语境的表达。

question: I've given you my advice; whether or not you act on it is ______ to you.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查固定搭配的用法，特别是与"be + 形容词/副词 + to"结构相关的短语。重点在于识别 "be up to someone" 这一常见表达的含义和用法。句意为：“我已经给了你建议；你是否采纳，就______你了。”空格处需要填入一个介词或副词，与 is...to you 构成固定搭配，表达“由某人决定”的意思。

question: Because the shop ______, all the T-shirts are sold at half price.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查动词时态与语境逻辑的匹配，特别是现在完成时、一般过去时、现在进行时和过去完成时在具体语境中的正确使用。关键在于理解“店铺关闭”这一动作与“T 恤半价出售”之间的逻辑关系——即：是因为即将关闭、已经关闭，还是正在关闭？句意为：“因为这家店______，所有的 T 恤都半价出售。”从常识和商业行为来看，商家通常在即将停业或正在清仓时打折促销，目的是在关门之前尽快卖出库存。因此，“半价出售”这一行为通常发生在店铺尚未完全关闭但即将关闭的时候，而不是在已经彻底关门之后（因为关门后无法再销售商品）。所以，这里应强调“正在关闭”或“即将关闭”的过程。

question: Would you please ______ this form for me to see if I've filled it in right or not?
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查动词短语的辨析与语境理解能力。四个选项均为常见动词短语，需结合句意判断哪个短语最符合“检查表格是否填写正确”这一语境。句子为请求语气，核心含义是：请对方帮忙“查看/检查”这份表格，以确认自己是否填写正确。因此，空格处应填入一个表示“仔细查看、检查、审阅”之意的动词短语。

question: The building around the corner caught fire last night. The police are ______ the matter now.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查动词短语的辨析与语境适用性，重点在于理解各选项短语的固定搭配含义及其在句子中的逻辑合理性。句子前半部分提到“街角的那栋楼昨晚着火了”，后半句说“警方现在正在______这件事”。显然，此处需要一个表示“调查、查办”含义的动词短语，以说明警方对火灾事件采取的行动。

question: I can't make ______ the one who is coming.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查的是英语中常用动词短语的搭配与意义，特别是 make 与不同介词/副词搭配后所构成的短语动词在具体语境中的正确使用。句意应为“我看不清/辨认不出来的人是谁。”或“我无法分辨正在走来的那个人。”关键在于选择一个与 make 搭配、且能表达“辨认出、看清、理解”等含义的副词或介词。

question: The family members do not agree with each other; ______, no decision has been made.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查逻辑连接副词（或连词）的语义与语用功能，重点在于理解句子之间的逻辑关系——此处为因果关系还是转折、递进或对比关系。前半句 "The family members do not agree with each other" 说明家庭成员意见不一致；后半句 "no decision has been made" 表示尚未做出决定。显然，后者是前者导致的结果：因为意见不统一，所以无法做出决定。因此，空格处应填入一个表示“因此、所以”等因果关系的连接副词。

question: He was such a ______ smoker that he developed lung cancer late in life.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查的是英语中与 smoker（吸烟者）搭配的形容词的惯用表达，重点在于词汇搭配和语义准确性。需要判断哪个形容词最自然、最符合英语母语者的表达习惯，用来描述“吸烟量大”的人。句子意为：“他是一个如此______的吸烟者，以至于晚年患上了肺癌。”空格处需要填入一个形容词，修饰 smoker，强调其吸烟的程度之重，从而导致健康问题（肺癌）。因此，该形容词应能准确表达“吸烟量大”或“烟瘾重”的含义。

question: The twins look so much ______ that people always mistake one for another.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查形容词和副词的辨析，特别是用于描述“相似性”的词汇用法，以及它们在句中的语法位置和搭配习惯。主语是 The twins，谓语是 look，后面接程度副词 so much 修饰空格处的词，再引导结果状语从句 "that people always mistake one for another"。关键在于：look 是系动词（linking verb），后面通常接形容词作表语；但此处有 so much 修饰，需注意哪些词可以被 so much 修饰，并符合语义“看起来非常相像”。

question: I can hardly hear the radio. Would you please ______?
explain: 参考答案:C 本题主要考查动词短语在特定语境中的辨析与应用，核心考点为与音量控制相关的短语动词的正确使用，包括 turn on（打开）、turn off（关闭）、turn down（调低）、turn up（调高）。句子 "I can hardly hear the radio." 表示“我几乎听不到收音机的声音”，说明音量太小。接下来的问句 "Would you please ______?" 是一种礼貌请求，请求对方做某个动作。因此，空格处应填入一个表示“把音量调大”的动作，以便能听清楚。

question: He is ______ because he has won the prize.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查的是形容词的用法，特别是以-ing和-ed结尾的形容词的区别。-ing 结尾的形容词通常用来描述事物或情境的特征，表示“令人……的”；而 -ed 结尾的形容词通常用来描述人的感受，表示“感到……的”。因此，选择正确的形容词形式需根据主语是人还是物，以及语境中表达的是主观感受还是客观性质。句子主语是 He，指一个人；谓语部分为 is ______，需要填入一个形容词来描述他的情绪状态。原因状语 "because he has won the prize" 表明他因为获奖而产生某种情绪。因此，这里应选择一个描述“人感到……”的形容词，强调他内心的情绪反应。

question: Here is my business card. Let's keep in ______.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查固定搭配和常用表达。句子中的 keep in ______ 是一个常见的英语习语结构，通常用于表达人与人之间保持某种联系或沟通状态。正确答案需要符合英语母语者的习惯用法。句意为：“这是我的名片。让我们保持联系。”空格前是 keep in，后面需要填入一个名词，构成“keep in + 名词”的固定搭配。四个选项均为抽象名词，但只有一个是符合英语习惯搭配的正确表达。

question: The teacher raised his ______ in order to be heard clearly by the students at the back.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查的是英语中与“声音”相关的名词辨析，特别是 voice、cry、sound 和 noise 在具体语境中的使用区别。这些词都与“声音”有关，但含义和用法不同：voice 指人说话、唱歌时发出的声音；cry 通常指哭声或突然的喊叫，带有情感色彩；sound 是最广义的“声音”，指任何可听见的声响；noise 多指嘈杂、刺耳或不悦耳的声音。本题语境强调教师为了让学生听清楚而提高某种“声音”，应选择与“说话声”相关的词。句子意思是：“老师提高他的______，以便让后面的学生听清楚。”关键动词是 raised（提高），宾语应是老师发出的、用于教学交流的声音。因此，应选择表示“说话的声音”的词。

question: They want to make ______ clear that they are doing an important and necessary job.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查的是形式宾语结构中的代词用法，特别是 "make it clear that..." 这一固定句型的正确使用。在英语中，当动词（如 make, find, consider 等）后接形容词和 that 引导的名词性从句时，若宾语较长，常用 it 作形式宾语，将真正的宾语从句置于句末。结构为 "make + it + 形容词 + that 从句"。空格处需要填入一个代词，作为动词 make 的形式宾语，而 "that they are doing an important and necessary job" 是真正的宾语从句。正确的结构应为 "make it clear that..."，表示“使……变得明确”。

question: They went to a ______ village to visit an old friend.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查的是形容词与副词的词性辨析及其在句中的语法功能，特别是修饰名词时应使用形容词的问题。句子中空格后接名词 village，因此需要一个能修饰名词的形容词，而不是副词。空格位于不定冠词 a 和名词 village 之间，显然需要填入一个形容词来修饰 village。四个选项中，有些是副词，有些是形容词，需判断哪个词既符合词性要求，又符合语义逻辑。

question: I would go to Rome if I ______ time.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查虚拟语气的用法，特别是与现在事实相反的假设条件下，主句和从句的时态搭配。在英语中，当表示与现在事实相反的假设时，if 条件从句使用一般过去时（动词用过去式），而主句则使用“would + 动词原形”。主句使用了 I would go，这是典型的虚拟语气结构，表示说话人目前并没有去罗马，是一种假设情况。因此，该句表达的是与现在事实相反的假设——“我现在没有时间，所以不去罗马；如果我有时间，我就会去。”在这种情况下，if 从句应使用一般过去时来表示虚拟，即 "if I had time"。

question: We all know that ______ speak louder than words.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查的是英语中常见的习语以及名词词义辨析。空格处需填入一个复数形式的名词，与后面的 words 形成对比，表达“某种行为或表现比言语更有说服力”的含义。这是英语中一个固定表达方式。句意为：“我们都知道，______比言语更有分量。”这是一个广为人知的英语谚语，强调实际行动比口头承诺更重要。因此，正确选项应为能体现“行为”“行动”的名词，且该名词在语法上可用作复数主语（即谓语用 speak 说明主语为复数）。

question: Only when you have acquired a good knowledge of grammar ______ write correctly.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查的是英语中的倒装句结构，特别是 "only + 状语从句" 置于句首时引起的部分倒装。当 only 修饰状语（如时间、方式、条件等）并位于句首时，主句需要使用部分倒装语序，即助动词或情态动词提前至主语之前。句意为：“只有当你掌握了扎实的语法知识时，你才能正确地写作。”Only when... 引导的时间状语从句位于句首，因此主句必须使用部分倒装结构。正常语序应为："You can only write correctly when..."，但因 only when 提前，主句需倒装。

question: The best way to ______ this goal is to introduce some advanced technology.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查动词与名词搭配的语义辨析，特别是动词与抽象名词 goal (目标) 的常见搭配。英语中，不同的动词与 goal 搭配时，表达的意义有所不同，需根据语境选择最符合逻辑和习惯用法的动词。句意为：“实现这一目标的最佳方法是引入一些先进技术。”空格处需要填入一个及物动词，能够与 this goal 构成合理的动宾搭配，且语义上表示“达成、完成目标”。因此，应选择一个表示“实现、达成”目标的动词。

question: ______ carefully, the patient left the hospital.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查非谓语动词的用法，特别是现在分词完成被动形式在句中的逻辑关系和时态语态的正确运用。关键在于分析分词短语与主句主语之间的主被动关系以及动作发生的先后顺序。句子主干是 "The patient left the hospital"，主语是 the patient（病人），谓语是 left。空格处为非谓语动词短语作状语，修饰主句动作 left。需要判断这个非谓语动作（检查）与主语 the patient 之间的关系，以及时间先后。逻辑分析：病人是“被检查”的对象，因此“检查”这个动作应为被动语态；而且“检查”发生在“离开医院”之前，即先被检查，然后才离开，因此需要用完成时态。综上，应使用现在分词的完成被动形式。

question: It is no use ______ a lot without doing anything.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查的是英语中“It is no use + 动名词”这一固定句型的用法。该结构表示“做某事是没有用的”，其中 it 为形式主语，真正的主语是后面的动名词短语。此结构要求动词以动名词（即动词-ing 形式）出现，不能使用不定式、动词原形或过去分词。句意为：“光说不做是没有用的。”空格处需要填入一个动词形式，作真正主语，与 "It is no use" 构成完整意义。根据语法规则，只有动名词形式符合该句型要求。

question: The girl with long hair was speaking to the old man who was all ______ black.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查介词的固定搭配，特别是"in + 颜色"这一常见表达方式，用于描述某人穿着某种颜色的衣服。例如，in black 表示“穿着黑色衣服”，in red 表示“穿着红色衣服”等。这是英语中描述衣着颜色的惯用结构。句意为：“那个长发女孩正在和那位老人说话”。后半部分 "who was all ______ black" 修饰 the old man，描述这位老人的穿着或外表。关键在于 all ______ black 这一短语，需要选择一个介词与 black 搭配，表达“全身穿着黑色”或“一身黑”的意思。

question: I am sure ______ you said is wrong.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查名词性从句的连接词用法。具体来说，是选择能引导宾语从句并在从句中充当成分的连接词。句子中 I am sure 后接一个宾语从句，该从句本身又是一个主语从句（______ you said 作为主语，is wrong 作为谓语），因此连接词需在从句中充当 said 的宾语。空白处需要填入一个连接词，引导从句 "______ you said is wrong" 作为 sure 的宾语。从句中 you said 是及物动词短语，缺少宾语，因此连接词必须能充当 said 的宾语，同时引导整个从句。

question: Is this the reason ______ you are against the suggestion?
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查定语从句中关系副词或关系代词的选择，重点在于先行词的意义以及其在从句中所充当的成分。当先行词是表示“原因”的名词（如 reason）时，引导定语从句的关系词需根据其在从句中的语法功能来判断使用 why、that、which 或 where。主句是 "Is this the reason"，后面接一个定语从句修饰先行词 the reason。需要判断空格处应填入哪个关系词来引导这个定语从句，并在从句中充当合适的成分。从句部分是：you are against the suggestion。需分析 the reason 在从句中是否作主语、宾语，还是表示地点、时间、原因等抽象关系。观察从句 "you are against the suggestion"：主语是 you，谓语是 are against，宾语是 the suggestion。该从句结构完整，不缺主语或宾语。那么，the reason 在从句中不是作主语或宾语，而是表示“你反对建议的原因”。也就是说，从句与先行词之间是因果关系，且 reason 在逻辑上是原因，因此需要用表示原因的关系副词。

question: She heard so ______ funny stories in the camp.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查的是不可数名词与可数名词的修饰词用法，以及常见量化词的搭配规则。重点在于区分 many 用于可数名词复数，much 用于不可数名词，a lot 和 plenty 虽然也可表示“大量”，但语法结构和搭配有所不同。空格后是 funny stories，其中 stories 是可数名词的复数形式。因此，修饰它的量化词必须能修饰可数名词复数。so 是一个加强语气的副词，常与 many、much 连用，构成 so many 或 so much 的固定搭配。我们需要选择一个能与 so 搭配、且能修饰可数名词复数的选项。

question: I couldn't get used to ______ to work so early.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查的是动词搭配和非谓语动词的用法，特别是 get used to 这一固定结构的语法特点。get used to 意为“逐渐习惯于”，其中的 to 是介词，后面应接名词或动名词（即动词的-ing 形式），而不是动词原形或从句。句意为：“我无法习惯这么早去上班。”主语是 I，谓语是 "couldn't get used to"，后面需要接一个宾语成分。关键在于理解 get used to 中的 to 是介词，因此后面必须接名词或动名词，不能接动词原形或过去式。

question: He is the only one of the boys who ______ English for four years.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题主要考查定语从句中的主谓一致以及现在完成时的用法。关键在于判断先行词在定语从句中的主语及其单复数形式，同时结合时间状语 for four years 判断时态。该句的主句是 "He is the only one of the boys..."，其中 who 引导的是定语从句，修饰先行词 "the only one of the boys"。注意：先行词是 "the only one of the boys"，而不是 the boys。因此，定语从句的主语是 the only one，即 "the boy who is the only one"，所以从句谓语动词应为单数形式。此外，for four years 表示动作从过去持续到现在，应使用现在完成时（have/has + 过去分词）。因此，谓语动词应使用 has learned。

question: We all know the truth ______ the earth moves around the sun.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查的是同位语从句的引导词用法。同位语从句用于对前面的名词（如 truth, fact, idea, news 等）进行解释或补充说明，通常由 that 引导，且 that 在从句中不作成分，只起连接作用。句子主干是 "We all know the truth..."，后面接一个从句 "the earth moves around the sun" 来具体说明 the truth 是什么。这个从句是对 truth 的内容进行解释，因此是一个同位语从句。需要选择一个能够引导同位语从句的连接词。

question: By the time you receive this message, I ______ for China.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查的是动词时态的正确使用，特别是 by the time 引导的时间状语从句中主句应使用的时态。当主句的动作在从句动作发生之前已经完成，且强调“将来某一时间之前已完成的动作”时，应使用将来完成时（will have + 过去分词）。"By the time you receive this message" 表示“当你收到这条消息的时候”，这是一个将来时间点。主句描述的是在这个将来时间点“已经发生”的动作——即“我已动身前往中国”。因此，主句应使用将来完成时，表示在将来某一时间点之前已完成的动作。

question: ______ I decided not to work in England, I still want to learn English.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查连词或介词短语在复合句中的正确使用，重点在于理解主从句之间的逻辑关系（让步关系），以及各个选项的语法功能和语义差异。句中前后两部分存在转折意味：前半句表达“我决定不在英国工作”，后半句表达“我仍然想学英语”，说明尽管有前者的情况，后者依然成立，因此应使用表示让步关系的连接词。空格位于句首，后面接的是 "I decided not to work in England" 这一完整的主谓结构，随后是主句 "I still want to learn English"。因此，空格处需要一个能够引导让步状语从句的连词，或者具有类似功能的介词结构。我们需要判断哪个选项既能语法正确地引导从句，又能准确表达“尽管”的让步含义。

question: We should have an extra bedroom ______ the guests want to stay overnight.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查的是状语从句的连接词用法，特别是表示“以防，万一”的条件状语从句引导词。需要根据句意判断应使用表示假设或预防性条件的连词。句子主干为："We should have an extra bedroom"（我们应该有一间额外的卧室），后接从句说明原因或条件。从句内容是 "the guests want to stay overnight"（客人想留宿）。整个句子表达的是一种预防性的安排：为了应对客人可能留宿的情况，我们应准备一间额外的卧室。因此，空格处需要一个表示“以防，万一”的连词。

question: I can see the rainbow clearly now that the rain ______.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题主要考查动词时态的运用，特别是现在完成时与一般过去时的区别，以及主从句之间的时态呼应关系。句中的时间状语 now that 引导原因状语从句，表示“既然……”，强调主句动作发生的原因，因此从句中的动作应与主句的现在时间有逻辑关联。主句为 "I can see the rainbow clearly"，使用一般现在时，表示当前的状态或能力。从句 "now that the rain ______" 说明“雨停了”是“我现在能清楚看到彩虹”的原因。因此，从句中动词的时态应体现“雨停”这一动作对现在造成的影响——即雨已经停了，所以现在才能看到彩虹。这种“过去的动作对现在造成影响”的语境，是现在完成时的典型用法。

question: Many people complain of the rapid ______ of modern life.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查名词词义辨析，特别是与 modern life（现代生活）搭配的抽象名词，侧重于表达“生活节奏”或“发展速度”的语境。需要根据固定搭配和语义逻辑选择最合适的名词。句意为：“许多人抱怨现代生活的快速______。”关键词是 rapid（快速的）和 modern life（现代生活），常用于描述生活节奏快、压力大。因此，空格处应填入一个能与 rapid 搭配，并能表达“速度”或“节奏”含义的名词。需要从四个选项中找出最符合语境的词。

question: You should never do that again. It ______ harm to the environment.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查动词与抽象名词搭配的固定用法，特别是“对……造成伤害”这一表达方式。句中的 harm 是抽象名词，表示“伤害、损害”，常与某些特定动词搭配使用，构成固定搭配。句子 "You should never do that again. It ______ harm to the environment." 意为“你永远不要再那样做了。那会对环境造成伤害。”空格处需要填入一个能与 harm 正确搭配的动词，表达“造成伤害”之意。关键在于识别 do harm to... 这一固定搭配。

question: For a company to succeed, good management is ______.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查的是形容词在语境中的正确使用，尤其是从语义角度判断哪个形容词最符合句子逻辑。句子表达的是“公司成功”与“管理”之间的关系，需要选择一个能体现“良好管理”对公司成功具有重要性的形容词。句意为：“一家公司要想成功，良好的管理是______的。”空格处需要填入一个形容词，用来描述“良好的管理”在公司成功过程中所扮演的角色。根据常识和逻辑，良好的管理是公司成功的关键因素之一，因此应选择一个表示“必不可少”或“至关重要”的词。

question: We must work hard to ______ the lost time.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查的是动词短语的搭配及其意义辨析，特别是 make up 的不同介词搭配在语境中的正确使用。核心在于理解“弥补失去的时间”这一语义应如何通过正确的动词+介词结构表达。句意为：“我们必须努力工作，以弥补失去的时间。”关键词是 the lost time（失去的时间），这暗示需要“弥补”或“补偿”某种损失。因此，应选择一个表示“弥补（损失、时间、过错等）”的动词短语。

question: I chose these because they are my ______ colors.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查形容词的语义辨析及固定搭配的使用，尤其是与 colors 搭配时，表达“我最喜欢的颜色”的正确表达方式。重点在于理解各个选项的词义及其在语境中的适用性。句意为：“我选择了这些，因为它们是我的______颜色。”空格处需要填入一个形容词，修饰 colors，并能与 my 搭配，表达“个人偏爱”的含义。逻辑上，选择某物的原因通常是“喜欢”或“最喜欢”，因此应选择表达“最喜爱的”这一含义的形容词。

question: The high building stands out ______ the sky.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查介词的用法，特别是介词在描述物体空间位置关系时的准确选择。关键在于理解 stand out 这一短语与不同介词搭配时的语义差异，以及“背景衬托”这一常见表达方式。句意为“这座高楼在天空的映衬下显得突出”。其中，stand out 表示“突出、显眼”，通常用于描述某物因与背景形成对比而引人注意。因此，空格处需要填入一个能表达“以……为背景”的介词。

question: It is very ______ to shop on the Internet. All you need is an online bank account.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查形容词的语义辨析及语境理解能力。要求根据句子的语境选择一个最符合逻辑和意义的形容词，描述“在网上购物”的特点。句意为：“在网上购物非常______。你所需要的只是一个网上银行账户。”后一句“你只需要一个网上银行账户”表明整个过程简单、容易操作，因此空格处应填入一个表示“方便、便捷”的积极形容词。

question: Canned foods are ______ with housewives because it takes so little time to cook them.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查形容词的辨析及固定搭配。题目中需要选择一个形容词来描述“罐头食品”与“家庭主妇”之间的关系，同时结合句子语境判断哪个选项最符合逻辑和习惯用法。句子的意思是“罐头食品因为烹饪时间短而受到家庭主妇的______。”从语境来看，这里需要一个表示“受欢迎”或“喜爱”的形容词，且要符合英语的习惯表达。

question: In fact, Peter would rather leave for Beijing than ______ in Shanghai.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查的是 would rather...than... 结构的用法。该结构表示“宁愿...而不愿...”，其中 than 前后需要保持平行结构，即“would rather + 动词原形”和“than + 动词原形”。句子中 "Peter would rather leave for Beijing" 表明这是一个 would rather...than... 结构，leave 是动词原形，因此 than 后面也需要使用动词原形。

question: I hope we'll meet ______ in August.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查的是英语中与“时间”相关的词汇辨析，特别是 sometimes、sometime、some times 和 some time 的用法区别。这些词汇虽然拼写相似，但意义和用法完全不同。句子的意思是“我希望我们能在八月的某个时候见面”。根据上下文，这里需要一个表示“某个不确定的时间点”的词或短语。

question: She hasn't decided with ______ she should first make contact.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查的是介词后接宾语从句中的关系代词的用法。句子中 "with ______ she should first make contact" 是一个介词后接宾语从句的结构，需要选择一个正确的关系代词来完成句子。句子的意思是“她还没有决定首先应该与谁联系”。这里的关键在于 with 后面的宾语从句中缺少宾语，因此需要一个能够充当宾语的关系代词。

question: Do you still remember the day ______ we visited the museum together last month?
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查定语从句中关系词的选择。需要根据句子结构和先行词的性质，选择正确的关系词。句子中的先行词是 the day，表示时间。定语从句 "we visited the museum together last month" 用来修饰 the day。我们需要选择一个关系词，使定语从句能够正确地修饰先行词。

question: ______ time went on, it got colder and colder.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查的是时间状语从句的引导词用法，重点在于区分不同连词的意义和用法，以及它们在句子中的逻辑关系。句子的意思是“随着时间的推移，天气变得越来越冷。”需要选择一个合适的连词来引导时间状语从句，表达“随着时间推移”的逻辑关系。

question: Hardly ______ come into the room ______ the meeting began.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查的是倒装句和固定搭配的用法。具体来说，涉及 Hardly...when... 这一结构，表示“一...就...”。在该结构中，Hardly 引导的部分需要用部分倒装，且主句通常使用过去完成时（had done），从句使用一般过去时。句子的意思是“他们刚进入房间，会议就开始了”。根据 Hardly...when... 的语法规则，主句需要倒装，并且时态为过去完成时，从句使用一般过去时。

question: I wanted to go shopping, but the rain ______ heavy, so I decided to stay at home.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查的是动词时态的使用，特别是过去时态的选择。句子描述的是过去某一时刻的情况，需要根据上下文选择合适的时态。句子的意思是“我本来想去购物，但雨______很大，所以我决定待在家里。”根据句意，这里需要一个表示过去某一时刻的雨的状态的动词形式。

question: She's passed the test, ______.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查的是英语中的倒装结构，特别是“so + 助动词/情态动词/be 动词 + 主语”的用法。这种结构用于表示前面提到的情况也适用于另一个人或事物。句子 "She's passed the test, ______" 中，She's passed 是现在完成时的结构，其中 's 是 has 的缩写形式。因此，这里需要一个与前面句子时态一致的倒装句来表达“我也通过了考试”的意思。

question: The boy was ______ because his toy was broken.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查形容词的语义辨析，要求根据句子的逻辑关系选择最合适的形容词。题目中提到 "his toy was broken"（他的玩具坏了），这显然是一个负面的情境，因此需要选择一个能表达负面情绪的形容词。句子的意思是“这个男孩因为他的玩具坏了而感到______”。根据上下文，“玩具坏了”通常会让人感到不开心或沮丧，所以正确答案应该是一个表示负面情绪的词。

question: I will climb Mt. Everest some day. That's the goal I want to ______.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查动词的语义辨析，重点在于理解句子中 goal（目标）与选项中动词的搭配关系。需要选择一个最符合逻辑和语境的动词。句子的意思是“我总有一天会攀登珠穆朗玛峰，那是我想______的目标。”根据上下文，goal 通常与表示“实现”或“达成”的动词搭配，因此正确答案应能表达“实现目标”的含义。

question: Please keep a(n) ______ on my suitcase while I am buying my ticket.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查固定搭配和名词的正确使用。句子中 "keep a(n) ______ on" 是一个常见的短语，要求能够识别正确的搭配，并理解其意义。句子的意思是“当我买票的时候，请帮我______我的行李箱。”根据上下文，这里需要一个表示“注意、看管”的词，以完成句子的逻辑表达。

question: Weather experts have ______ that it will be extremely hot next summer.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查动词的语义辨析，要求根据句子的语境选择最合适的动词。句子的主题是“天气专家对明年夏天天气状况的判断”，因此需要选择一个与“预测”相关的动词。句子的意思是“天气专家已经______明年夏天将会极其炎热。”根据上下文，空格处需要填入一个表示“预测、推测”的动词。

question: Violence programs on television may have a bad ______ on children.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查名词的辨析，重点在于理解句子语境以及选项中名词的具体含义和搭配。句子的意思是“电视上的暴力节目可能对儿童产生不良______。”根据句意，这里需要一个能与 have a bad 搭配并符合逻辑的名词，表示某种影响或作用。

question: The new English-Chinese dictionary I lent her ______ me almost 20 dollars.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查的是动词的用法，特别是与金钱相关的动词（cost, take, pay, spend）的区别。这些动词在英语中都有“花费”的意思，但它们的主语、宾语和句式结构不同。句子的意思是“我借给她的那本新英汉词典花了我将近20美元”。需要选择一个动词来填空，使句子语法正确且意义通顺。

question: You should not try to ______ while others are talking.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查动词的语义辨析，要求根据句子语境选择最合适的动词。句子的意思是“当别人在说话时，你不应该尝试______。”需要从四个选项中选出一个符合语境的动词。句子的核心是 "while others are talking"（当别人在说话时），这提示我们所选动词应与“别人正在说话”这一情境相关联。结合常识，当别人在说话时，不应该做的是“打断”或类似的行为。

question: They live two kilometers ______ from the railway station.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查介词的用法，特别是表示距离和位置关系的介词。需要根据句子语境选择合适的介词来完成句子。句子的意思是“他们住在离火车站两公里的地方”。这里的关键是理解 "two kilometers ______ from the railway station" 中空格处应填入的介词，用来正确表达距离和方向的关系。

question: Children who are over-protected by their parents may become ______.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查形容词的辨析，重点在于理解句子语境和选项中词汇的具体含义。题目描述的是“被父母过度保护的孩子可能会变得...”，需要选择一个最符合语境的形容词。句子表达了一种因果关系：由于父母过度保护，孩子可能会产生某种负面结果。因此，正确答案应该是一个能够准确描述这种负面结果的形容词。

question: As they don't have a child of their own, they are going to ______ a little girl.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查动词辨析，重点在于区分四个选项（accept, receive, acquire, adopt）在语境中的具体含义和用法。句子的意思是“因为他们没有自己的孩子，所以他们打算______一个小女孩。”根据上下文，这里需要一个表示“收养”或“接纳”的动词。

question: Quite a lot of people watch TV in order to ______ time.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查动词短语的搭配及语境理解。句子表达的是“很多人看电视的目的”，需要根据上下文选择最合适的动词，使句子语义通顺且符合逻辑。句子中 "in order to ______ time" 是一个目的状语结构，表示“为了...时间”。结合选项，需判断哪个动词能与 time 搭配，并符合句意。

question: The key ______ success is hard work and persistence.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查的是固定搭配和介词的用法。英语中，某些名词与特定介词搭配使用时具有固定的表达方式，需要掌握这些搭配以正确完成句子。句子的意思是“成功的关键在于努力工作和坚持。”其中，"the key ______ success" 是一个固定搭配，表示“...的关键”。我们需要选择正确的介词来完成这一搭配。

question: We finally ______ an agreement after three months of hard bargaining.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查动词短语的搭配及语境运用能力，特别是与 agreement（协议）相关的常用搭配。句子的意思是“经过三个月的艰难谈判，我们最终______了一项协议”。根据上下文，空格处需要填入一个能与 agreement 搭配的动词，表示达成或完成协议的动作。

question: Even when Jone was in his sixties, he took part in swimming competitions and a lot of younger people couldn't ______ him.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查动词短语的辨析，重点在于理解各个选项的含义及其在句子中的适用性。题目中需要选择一个能够与句子语境和逻辑相符的短语。句子的意思是“即使 Jone 已经六十多岁，他仍然参加游泳比赛，并且许多年轻人都无法______他。”根据上下文，这里需要一个表示“跟上”或“赶上”的短语，以体现年轻人无法与 Jone 相比或匹敌。

question: You can't afford to let the situation get worse. You must take ______ to put it right.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查的是固定搭配和名词的用法。句子中 "take ______ to put it right" 是一个关键结构，需要选择一个合适的名词与 take 搭配，表达采取某种行动来解决问题的意思。句子的意思是：“你不能让情况变得更糟。你必须采取______来纠正它。”根据上下文，这里需要一个能够表示“行动”或“措施”的名词。

question: Mike is the boy ______ scored the winning points for the basketball team.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查定语从句中关系代词的正确使用。关键在于判断先行词的性质（人或物）以及关系代词在从句中所作的成分（主语或宾语），从而选择恰当的关系代词。先行词是 the boy，指人，因此可以排除用于指物的关系代词 which 和不用干定语从句的 what。接下来需要判断从句中缺少的成分，scored 是从句的谓语动词，而从句缺少主语，因此应选择能充当主语且指人的关系代词。

question: They lost their way in the forest, and ______ made the matter worse was that night began to fall.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题主要考查名词性从句中的主语从句用法，特别是连接代词 what 引导主语从句的语法功能。此外，还涉及 "make the matter worse" 这一固定表达的语义理解。前半句是完整独立的句子，表示“他们在森林里迷路了”；后半句由并列连词 and 连接，构成并列句。后半句的主干是 "______ made the matter worse was that night began to fall"，其中 was 是系动词，后面 "that night began to fall" 是表语从句。因此，空格处应填入一个能充当主语从句主语的连接词，整个主语从句是 "______ made the matter worse"。该主语从句中缺少主语，且这个主语需要表达“...的事情”这一含义。选项中的连接词必须既能引导从句，又能在从句中作主语，并具有实际意义（即指代事物）。

question: To know what is good and ______ are two different things.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题主要考查英语中的平行结构。在英语语法中，当两个或多个并列的成分（如主语、谓语、宾语、表语等）由并列连词（如 and, or, but）连接时，这些成分应在语法形式上保持一致，即具有相同的词性或结构。句子主干结构是："A and B are two different things"，其中 are 为复数谓语动词，说明主语是由 A and B 构成的复数主语。因此，A 和 B 应为并列的两个主语成分，且结构应保持一致。已知 A 部分是 "To know what is good"（不定式短语作主语），因此 B 部分也应是一个结构相同的不定式短语，以保持平行结构。

question: We've produced ______ cotton this year as we did in 2020.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查的是倍数表达法的用法。英语中，倍数表达通常遵循以下结构：倍数词 + as + 形容词/副词原级 + as 或 倍数词 + 比较级 + than。题目要求选择正确的倍数表达形式。句子的意思是“我们今年生产的棉花是2020年的两倍”。根据倍数表达法的规则，正确结构应为 倍数词（twice）+ as much + 名词（cotton）+ as。

question: I'll leave him a note ______ he'll know where we are.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查的是目的状语从句的用法。目的是选择一个合适的连接词，使句子表达“我留给他一张便条，以便他知道我们在哪里”的意思。句子中需要填入的部分是用来引导目的状语从句的连接词或短语，表示“为了”或“以便”的意思。根据上下文逻辑，句子强调的是结果或目的，因此需要选择能够正确表达这一含义的选项。

question: It was three years ago ______ my brother graduated from Stanford University.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查的是强调句型的用法。强调句型的基本结构是"It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其他部分"。此外，题目中涉及时间状语从句的逻辑关系。句子的意思是“我哥哥从斯坦福大学毕业已经是三年前的事情了。”根据句子结构，这里需要选择一个词来完成强调句型或时间状语从句。

question: The reason ______ come last night is that he had to attend an important meeting.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题主要考查时态的一致性和从句的时态匹配。关键点是时间状语 last night 表示过去时间，因此从句的动词时态需使用过去时。同时，主句 "The reason is that..." 使用现在时，但原因从句描述过去事件，时态上可以接受。空格处需填入一个从句，解释昨晚没来的原因。last night 是明确的时间状语，表明动作发生在过去，因此从句动词应使用过去时态。选项中的时态需与 last night 和主句保持一致。

question: They ______ us since five o'clock this morning.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题主要考查现在完成进行时的用法，表示从过去某个时间开始一直持续到现在的动作，并且这个动作可能还在进行。句子表达的是从今天早上五点开始直到现在的动作，强调的是这个帮助的动作一直在持续。

question: Without computers, much of today's advanced technology ______.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查虚拟语气在条件状语从句中的应用，特别是对过去情况的虚拟。句子表达的是如果没有计算机，今天很多先进的技术就不会达到现有的水平。这是一个对现在情况的虚拟，但因为"没有计算机"这个条件涉及的是对过去的假设（即在计算机发明之前或没有计算机的发展历程），所以实际上是对过去情况的结果进行虚拟描述。

question: Which one do you think is ______, tea or coffee?
explain: 参考答案:C 比较级的使用。这个句子是在比较茶和咖啡两者，询问哪一个更好。因此，我们需要使用比较级来表达这种比较关系。

question: I began to ______ when I was five years old.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题主要考察英语中“演奏乐器”的固定表达方式以及冠词的使用。句子意为“我五岁时开始______。”需要填入一个表示“弹钢琴”的短语。

question: ______, he is still working outside.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题主要考查倒装句的使用，特别是让步状语从句中的倒装结构。句子意在表达尽管太阳很热，他仍然在外面工作。英语中，当 as 或 though 引导让步状语从句时，常将表语或状语提前至句首，形成部分倒装结构。

question: It was not until she took off her dark glasses ______ I realized she was an old friend of mine.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查强调句型的用法，特别是 "It is/was not until...that..." 结构，用于强调时间状语。句子意在表达“直到她摘下墨镜，我才意识到她是我的位老朋友。”这里的重点是强调时间点，即“摘下墨镜的时候”。

question: This book is for students ______ native language is not English.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查定语从句中关系代词的使用，特别是 whose 引导的定语从句，用于指人或物的所有格。句子的大意是“这本书是为母语不是英语的学生准备的。”空缺部分需要一个关系代词来引导定语从句，修饰先行词 students，表达所有关系（即“学生的母语”）。关系代词在从句中作定语，修饰 native language。

question: From now on, I want to keep myself ______ of how things are going on with you.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题主要考查英语中“keep + 宾语 + 宾语补足语”结构的用法，以及动词 inform 的正确非谓语形式在被动语态中的应用。核心在于理解“keep oneself + 过去分词”表示“使自己处于某种状态”，且 inform 通常用于被动结构 be informed of 表示“被告知...”。句子意为“从现在起，我想让自己______你的事情进展如何。”此处需要一个表达“被通知”或“了解”的意思的短语来补充完整句子，使句意通顺。

question: Don't treat him as your friend. He is ______ a cheater.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题主要考察短语辨析，特别是表达否定和肯定的短语在具体语境中的应用。句意为“不要把他当作你的朋友，他__是个骗子。”需要填入的短语应当表达对“他是骗子”这一属性的强调或确认。

question: My grandpa, together with my grandma, ______ still working in the garden now.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题主要考查主谓一致的语法规则，特别是当主语后跟有 together with 引导的附加成分时，谓语动词应与主语保持一致，而不是与附加成分一致。句子的主语是 My grandpa，尽管后面有 "together with my grandma" 这一伴随结构，但伴随结构并不影响主语的数，因此谓语动词应与 My grandpa 保持一致，即使用单数形式。同时，根据句中的 still 和 now 时间状语，表明动作正在进行，因此需要使用现在进行时或表示当前状态的系动词。

question: Do you know ______?
options: what time does the movie start
explain: 参考答案:A 本题主要考查宾语从句的语序和时态规则。题目问的是“你知道电影几点开始吗？”，需要选择一个正确的宾语从句来完成句子，宾语从句在英语中遵循陈述句语序，即主语+谓语的顺序，并且在疑问句中引导词后直接跟陈述句语序。

question: ______ the United States is a big country, it is not the largest in the world.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题主要考察连词的使用，特别是引导让步状语从句的连词。句子的前半部分表达了一个事实（美国是一个大国），后半部分则提出了一个相对的事实（它并不是世界上最大的国家）。因此，需要一个能够表达这种对比或让步关系的连词来连接这两个部分。

question: The letter ______ I received yesterday was from a friend of mine.
explain: 参考答案:C 考察定语从句关系代词的使用。句子的主干是 "The letter was from a friend of mine."，空缺部分需要填入一个关系代词来引导定语从句，修饰先行词 letter，且在从句中作宾语。

question: All the children are getting excited and looking forward to ______ the new film and the film stars.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题主要考查英语中动词的非谓语形式，特别是 look forward to 这一固定搭配的语法结构。其中，to 是介词，后面必须接名词或动名词（即动词的-ing 形式），不能接动词原形。句意为“所有的孩子都越来越兴奋，期待着______新电影和电影明星。”空格处需要填入一个动词的适当形式，作为 look forward to 的宾语。由于 look forward to 中的 to 是介词，因此其后应接动名词（即动词的-ing 形式），表示“期待做某事”。

question: The police are busy ______ the crime at the moment.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查动词短语在具体语境中的使用，特别是与“调查”相关的短语。句子描述的是警察当前正忙于对犯罪行为的某种活动。我们需要找到一个与“调查犯罪”相匹配的短语。

question: Robert surprised every one of us when he ______ the job of office manager.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查动词短语在具体语境中的应用，特别是与“工作”相关的短语含义。句子讲述的是 Robert 让我们大家都感到惊讶的行为与办公室经理这个职位有关。turn down 意为“拒绝”，符合句意。

question: The key ______ success is hard work and persistence.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查介词的固定搭配，特别是与 key 搭配使用的介词。句子意为“成功的关键是努力工作和坚持。” the key to success 是固定搭配，表示“...的关键”。

question: The repairman examined the car engine ______ but could not find anything wrong with it.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题主要考察副词的用法，特别是如何准确描述维修工检查汽车引擎的过程。句子讲述的是维修工检查汽车引擎但没发现任何问题的情境，需要选择一个副词来修饰 examined（检查），以体现检查的程度或方式。thoroughly 意为“彻底地”，符合语境。

question: I agree with you to a certain ______ but not entirely.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查固定搭配中词汇的选择，主要涉及表达“在一定程度上”的短语。题目意为“我在某种程度上同意你的观点，但并不完全同意。” to a certain extent 是固定搭配，表示“在某种程度上”。

question: As they haven't a child of their own, they're going to ______ a little girl.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题主要考察动词的含义及在具体语境中的应用，特别是与“领养孩子”这一行为相关的动词辨析。句子讲述的是一对没有自己孩子的夫妇打算去做一件事情，与一个小女孩相关，根据常识和语境可以推测是与领养相关的行为。

question: He has been working ______ the experiment for over a month now.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查动词 work 与不同介词搭配的意义。句意为“他已经在实验上工作了一个多月了。” work on 表示从事某项工作或研究，符合题意。

question: To our delight, she quickly adapted herself ______ the new environment.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查固定搭配 adapt oneself to，意为“使自己适应于”。句子表达的意思是“令我们高兴的是，她迅速适应了新环境”。

question: We finally ______ an agreement after three months of hard bargaining.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题主要考察动词短语的搭配，特别是与“达成协议”相关联的动词。句子描述的是经过三个月的努力协商后，最终“达成了一项协议”。需要填入的动词应能准确表达这一含义。reach an agreement 是固定搭配，意为达成协议。

question: They use camels to ______ heavy things for a long distance.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题主要考察动词的含义及在特定语境下的正确使用，特别是与“运送”相关的几个动词的区别。句子描述的是用骆驼来运送重物进行长距离移动的情景。carry 强调携带、运送，符合题意。

question: The picture will always ______ me of the days spent here with you.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查动词词义辨析，特别是与“提醒、使想起”相关的动词用法。句意为“这张照片将永远使我______与你共度的时光。”空缺处需要填入一个动词，表示照片能够引起对过去时光的回忆。remind sb of sth 是固定搭配，意为使某人想起某事。

question: There is no ______ in trying to contact him as he is on a business trip.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题主要考查固定搭配和名词在特定语境中的用法，尤其是 "There is no + 名词 + in doing something" 这一句型的正确搭配。该结构用于表达“做某事是没有...的”，常与表示“意义、价值、用处、必要性”等抽象概念的名词连用。句意为“试图联系他是没有______的，因为他正在出差。”我们需要找到一个词，与 there is no 结合后，能够表达出在这种情况下尝试联系他是没有意义或没有必要的情感色彩。there is no point in doing sth 是固定句型，意为做某事没有意义。

question: The pilot of an airliner is responsible ______ the safety of the passengers.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查介词的固定搭配，特别是与 responsible 搭配使用的介词。句子的大意是“一名客机飞行员负责乘客的安全。” be responsible for 是固定搭配，意为对...负责。

question: She was ______ to tears when she heard the story.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查动词短语与上下文语境的搭配，特别是与情感反应相关的表达。句子讲述的是当她听到这个故事时，她的反应是到了流泪的程度。这里需要一个能与 to tears 搭配并表示情绪触动的动词。be moved to tears 是固定搭配，意为被感动得流泪。

question: The forest fire caused by the volcano is too difficult to ______.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查动词短语在特定语境中的使用，特别是与“火”相关的动词短语。句子讲述的是火山引发的森林火灾很难被怎样处理。我们需要找到一个与“控制或熄灭火灾”相关的短语。put out 意为扑灭，符合题意。

title: 第一篇 Leo的花园

question: The garden made him feel ______ to his wife, who was no longer alive.

title: 第一篇 Leo的花园
question: The flowers and plants were broken and lying ______ the mud.

title: 第一篇 Leo的花园
question: That morning, Ben saw Leo ______ so sad, so he stopped and said...

title: 第一篇 Leo的花园
question: Leo could not ______ and just nodded.

question: It was a question that made Leo realize that he, as an old man, could be ______ again.

question: Ben used his strength to ______ the broken plants.

title: 第一篇 Leo的花园
question: Leo used his knowledge to ______ him what to do.

question: It was not exactly the same, but it was ______ of life.

title: 第一篇 Leo的花园
question: Leo and Ben stood in the garden, talking and ______.

title: 第一篇 Leo的花园

question: He worked for free at a local shelter, serving meals and offering ______ to those in need.

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila
question: One cold winter evening, when Amir walked home, he ______ a young woman sitting by the roadside, sad and alone.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查动词的语义辨析。语境为 Amir 在寒冷的冬夜回家路上，发现/注意到路边坐着一个悲伤的女子，随后主动上前交谈。noticed 表示“注意到”，强调 Amir 主动察觉到她的存在。

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila
question: He went up and said ______ to her.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查日常交际用语。say hello to sb. 是固定搭配，表示“向某人问好/打招呼”。Amir 走近一位陌生女子，最可能的第一件事是打招呼，以表达关心和善意。

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila
question: Amir was told that her name was Lila, and that she had ______ her job and home due to unexpected circumstances.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查动词的语义辨析及上下文逻辑。结合 due to unexpected circumstances（由于意外情况）以及后文她需要找工作，说明她处于困境中，因此她是因为意外情况而“失去”了工作和家。lose one's job 意为失业。

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila
question: "Would you ______ something to eat?" he asked gently.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查固定搭配。Would you like something to eat? 是英语中非常固定的礼貌用语，用于提供食物或帮助，意为“你想吃点什么吗？”。

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila
question: Lila nodded and her eyes were filled ______ tears.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查固定搭配。be filled with 是固定表达，意为“充满”。此处描述 Lila 听到 Amir 请她吃饭的善意提议后，眼睛里充满了泪水，表示感动。

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila
question: Amir decided to ______ her to the shelter.

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila
question: Lila worked hard, ______ that she could rebuild her life.

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila
question: When she shared the news with Amir and the shelter team, ______ filled the room.

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila
question: They celebrated her achievement, tears of ______ running down their faces.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查名词词义辨析及固定搭配。tears of happiness 意为“喜悦的泪水”，与前文大家为她找到工作而庆祝的喜悦氛围完全吻合。

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila
question: Months later, Lila ______ to the shelter as a volunteer.
explain: 参考答案:A 本题考查动词辨析。结合后文 She wanted to give back（她想要回报），说明她回到了曾经帮助过她的收容所当志愿者。returned（返回）符合语境。

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila
question: She wanted to give back, just ______ Amir had done for her.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查连词用法。just as 意为“正如……一样”，引导方式状语从句。此处表达她想像 Amir 曾经为她做的那样去帮助别人。

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila
question: Amir's kindness had not only ______ Lila's life but also inspired others to help those in need.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查动词辨析。not only... but also...（不仅……而且……）连接两个并列的动作。Amir 的善良不仅“改变”了 Lila 的生活，还激励了其他人。changed（改变）符合逻辑。

title: 第二篇 Amir和Lila
question: At that moment, everyone realized that a ______ act of kindness can change one's life.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查形容词辨析。结合文章主旨，一个“简单的/单一的”善举（a single act of kindness）也能改变一个人的生活。single 强调一个微小的举动就能带来巨大的改变。

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇
question: One day, my mother got on the bus to ______ shopping.

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇
question: Mum ______ the conductor what those dogs were doing up there with the driver.

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇
question: Mum could hardly ______ it.
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查动词辨析。could hardly believe it 是固定表达，表示“难以置信”。结合上下文，狗自己坐公交的行为超出常人认知，母亲感到非常惊讶，因此是“难以相信”。

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇
question: The bus began to ______ , and after three stops the two dogs got off the bus.

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇
question: after three stops the two dogs got ______ the bus.

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇

explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查动词的语义搭配。send help 意为“派遣/提供援助”，符合语境：她意识到发生了什么并立刻派人去救助。

title: 2024年完形填空 第一篇

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇
question: he has a long skillful nose ______ trunk for a hand.

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇
question: He uses his trunk ______ than most men use their hands.

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇
question: He is the only animal ______ can be taught to push and pull.

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇
question: and it was wonderful to see how careful elephants were in ______ after them.
explain: 参考答案:B 本题考查动词短语搭配及上下文语义理解。空格位于介词 in 之后，构成 in___after them 结构，需选择一个能与 after 搭配、且符合“照顾孩子”语境的动词。look after 意为“照顾、照看”，符合题意。

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇
question: One elephant ______ a small baby girl so much that it used to stand over her bed...
explain: 参考答案:D 本题考查动词的语义辨析与上下文逻辑一致性。空格位于句子 "One elephant___a small baby girl so much that..." 中，后接 so much that... 结构，表明该动词需能与 so much 自然搭配，并引出后文描述的温情行为。结合上下文，后文提到大象细心照料婴儿的行为，此处表达的是大象对小女孩深厚的喜爱，loved 最符合语境。

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇
question: and ______ away the flies while the baby slept.
explain: 参考答案:C 本题考查动词与固定搭配的掌握。空格所在句为："...used to stand over her bed, and___away the flies while the baby slept." 句子描述的是大象在婴儿睡觉时为其驱赶苍蝇的行为。需要选择一个能与 away 搭配，且语义上表示“驱赶、赶走”苍蝇的动词。drive away 意为“赶走”，符合语境。

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇
question: When the baby grew restless, the elephant would ______ lift her to the floor...

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇
question: and let her ______ about between its legs.

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇
question: The baby also liked the elephant so much that she ______ to take any food if her friend was not standing by her.

question: One man even taught his female elephant ______ to do some housework.

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇
question: The moment the master gave his ______ , the elephant would immediately take a broom in her trunk...

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇
question: and ______ away the dead leaves in the garden.

question: The elephant also carefully ______ a large bottle of water for her master to water the flowers.

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇
question: When all the work was done, the elephant was ______ some food and water as a reward.

title: 2024年完形填空 第二篇

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 1
passage:
Too busy to go to the gym? Don't worry — you can stay healthy by adding at least 15 minutes of fast walking to your everyday routine, a new research suggests.
In general, it's recommended that people devote themselves to 150 minutes of moderate activity per week to see sufficient health benefits, said Dr. Zheng, the study's corresponding author. But if 150 minutes is too difficult to manage, (76) fast walking at least 15 minutes every day can have the same health benefits.
Dr. Zheng and a team of researchers investigated mostly low-income participants from 2002 to 2009. The nearly 85,000 participants were given a questionnaire about their exercise habits, average time spent working out, walking speed and health. Then the participants completed a follow-up questionnaire about 16 years later, and the analysis began in 2023.
"We know fast walking is good compared to slow walking, but there isn't much research on how many minutes you should spend in fast walking on average," said Dr. Zheng.
On average, the study participants who fast walked for at least 15 minutes every day saw a nearly 20% reduction in premature death, compared with a 4% reduction among participants who walked slowly for a total of more than three hours a day.
"We've actually known for quite a long time that walking speed is closely related to the results, meaning the faster you walk, the better you do. And it certainly makes sense because you can imagine somebody who's in really bad shape is probably not going to be able to walk very quickly," said Dr. Freeman, who was not involved in the study.
Walking has health benefits, such as managing weight and reducing sugar intake, reducing risk of cancer, easing joint pain, and improving all-around physical functions.
"Health experts know that when people are exercising regularly, blood vessels can relax and work a bit better. And we also know that exercise is quite good for cholesterol, so it seems to lower cholesterol, and then overall, it reduces the risk of cancer and things that would otherwise hurt people," said Dr. Freeman.
(77) "I want to emphasize that these exercises, whether slow or fast, all have some benefit," Dr. Zheng said. "But what we find is that fast walking as little as 15 minutes a day can give you as much benefit."
question: In general, how much time of moderate activity each week is good for one's health?
explain: 参考答案:C 细节理解题。题目问的是“一般来说，每周进行多少分钟的中等强度活动对健康有益？”定位到文章第二段开头："In general, it's recommended that people devote themselves to 150 minutes of moderate activity per week..." 这句话明确指出：一般建议人们每周进行150分钟的中等强度活动。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 1
question: The researchers collected follow-up data 16 years later in order to ______.

give participants time to join expensive fitness programs
finish building new gyms for low-income communities
wait till online service became available to analyze the data

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 1
question: Which of the following statements is TRUE according to the passage?

Fast walking can be protective against early death.
Cholesterol levels are unaffected by walking speed.
Gym membership is unnecessary for everyone.

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 2
passage:
The earliest cities arose in Mesopotamia, a region in modern-day Iraq located between the Tigris and Euphrates Rivers. Although the soil in Mesopotamia is extremely fertile, humans had avoided settling there much before 4,000 B.C. due to insufficient rainfall to provide the moisture necessary for growing crops. Apparently, however, starting around 4,000 B.C., population pressures drove people from neighbouring regions into this area, where they attempted to make a living as best they could. (78) Once there, they found that they could do this by constructing irrigation(灌溉) systems. Building and maintaining irrigation systems in turn called for a degree of planning and cooperative labour previously unknown in human societies.
The irrigation involved channeling water from the two major rivers across dry lands through canals and channels. This work was never truly finished as the canals constantly had to be cleared of thick mud buildup. Such labour demanded that people be organized in force, that provisions be assembled to support them, that pots be mass-produced to serve as food containers, and so forth. Obviously, therefore, planners were needed to determine how, when, and where to work, overseers(监工) were needed to direct and force labourers to work, and governors were needed to plan and manage the overseers. (79) Accordingly, society became divided into the rulers and the ruled.
The planners and overseers in the centuries after 4,000 B.C. lived in villages that were becoming cities, and so did another new element in society, priests(牧师). Of course, religion was not invented in Mesopotamia. Many thousands of years earlier, humans had placed provisions next to their dead, evidently because they believed in the life after death, and cave art was probably meant to call upon mysterious forces. What was new in Mesopotamia was the emergence of a full-time priesthood, whose work was widely trusted and supported by most of the labourers.
question: People avoided living in Mesopotamia before 4,000 B.C. due to ______.
options: lack of natural rainfall for farming
absence of clay for making pots
explain: 参考答案:A 细节理解题。题目问的是“人们在公元前4000年之前为什么避免在美索不达米亚定居”。定位到文章第二句："...humans had avoided settling there much before 4,000 B.C. due to insufficient rainfall to provide the moisture necessary for growing crops." 这句话明确指出，原因是“降雨不足（insufficient rainfall）”，无法为农作物提供必要的水分。直接对应选项A。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 2
question: The canals of Mesopotamia had to be cleared constantly because ______.
options: salt from the rivers poisoned the soil
thick mud continually built up in them
they were made of small stones
explain: 参考答案:B 细节理解题。题目问的是“美索不达米亚的运河为什么需要不断清理”。定位到第二段第二句："This work was never truly finished as the canals constantly had to be cleared of thick mud buildup." 意思是：这项工作从未真正完成过，因为运河需要不断清除厚厚的泥沙淤积（thick mud buildup）。直接对应选项B。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 2
question: According to this passage, there were full-time priests in Mesopotamia mainly because ______.
options: rulers wanted to encourage more immigrants
cave artists moved into the new cities
neighbouring regions had long religious tradition
their work was popular among the labourers
explain: 参考答案:D 细节理解题。题目问的是“美索不达米亚出现专职祭司的主要原因是什么”。定位到最后一段最后一句："What was new in Mesopotamia was the emergence of a full-time priesthood, whose work was widely trusted and supported by most of the labourers." 这句话指出，专职祭司的工作“被大多数劳动者广泛信任和支持”，说明其存在依赖于民众的认可，对应选项D。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 2
question: Which of the following statements is TRUE according to the passage?
options: Democracy resulted from organized cooperative labour division.
Mesopotamian cities disappeared after the irrigation canals were abandoned.
Religion was more important than agriculture in early Mesopotamian cities.
Complex social structures emerged as a direct response to organizational work.
explain: 参考答案:D 细节理解题。A选项未提及民主；B选项未提及城市消失；C选项未说宗教比农业重要。定位到第二段，由于组织性劳动的需要（planners, overseers, governors needed），社会被划分为统治者和被统治者（society became divided into the rulers and the ruled），这正对应了复杂社会结构的出现。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 2

options: Irrigation was first invented in Mesopotamia.
Irrigation systems in Mesopotamia contributed to the rise of urban society.
Mesopotamian priests invented religion to make people afraid of death.
The Tigris and Euphrates were the longest rivers in the ancient world.
explain: 参考答案:B 主旨大意题。文章第一段说人们通过建立灌溉系统在这里定居，第二段说灌溉工作促成了复杂的社会分工和统治结构的形成，第三段说随之出现了新的社会阶层（祭司）和逐渐形成的城市。全文的主线是：灌溉系统的发展促成了美索不达米亚城市社会的崛起。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 3
passage:
Most people are born creative. But over time, because of socialization and formal education, a lot of us start to hold back those urges. We learn to be more careful and more analytical. The world seems to divide into "creatives" and "noncreatives", and too many people resign themselves to the latter.
And yet we know that creativity is essential to success in any industry. According to a recent IBM survey of chief executives around the world, it's the most important quality in leaders today.
Students often come to Stanford University's "d.school" to develop their creativity. Clients(客户) work with our design and innovation team for the same reason. But along the way, we've learned that our job isn't to teach them creativity. It's to help them rediscover their creative confidence — the natural ability to come up with new ideas and the courage to try them out. We do this by giving them strategies to get past four fears that hold most of us back: fear of the unknown, fear of being judged, fear of the first step, and fear of losing control.
Consider the work of Albert Bandura, a famous psychologist and Stanford professor. In one series of early experiments, he helped people conquer lifelong snake phobia(恐惧症) by guiding them through a series of increasingly demanding interactions(互动). They would start by watching a snake through a two-way mirror. Once comfortable with that, they'd progress to observing it through an open door, then to watching someone else touch the snake, then to touching it themselves through a heavy leather glove, and, finally, in a few hours, to touching it with their own bare hands. Bandura calls this process of experiencing one small success after another "guided mastery." The people who went through it weren't just cured of a deep fear. (80) They also had less anxiety and more success in other parts of their lives, taking up new and potentially frightening activities like horseback riding and public speaking. They had gained a new confidence in their ability to attain what they set out to do.
question: According to the passage, many people stop being creative as they grow older mainly because of ______.
options: a common belief in lacking natural talent
explain: 参考答案:A 细节理解题。题目问的是“很多人随着年龄增长不再富有创造力的主要原因是什么”。定位到文章第一段第二句："But over time, because of socialization and formal education, a lot of us start to hold back those urges." 这句话直接说明：由于社会化（socialization）和正规教育（formal education），许多人开始压抑自己天生的创造冲动。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 3
question: In Bandura's experiments, the first step for participants to overcome snake phobia was ______.
options: touching the snake with a leather glove
observing someone else touching the snake
watching a snake through a two-way mirror
touching the snake with their bare hands
explain: 参考答案:C 细节理解题。题目问的是在 Bandura 的实验中，参与者克服蛇类恐惧症的“第一步”是什么。定位到第四段："They would start by watching a snake through a two-way mirror." 明确指出这是整个过程的起点。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 3
question: Bandura's "guided mastery" method indicates that ______.
options: gradual exposure to fearful situations helps build confidence
people must face their fears directly to achieve quick results
watching others is more effective than trying things themselves
long-term treatment is the only way to overcome deep fears
explain: 参考答案:A 推理判断题。题目要求判断 Bandura 的 guided mastery 方法体现的核心观点。根据原文，这种方法是循序渐进地（increasingly demanding interactions）让人接触恐惧源，体验一个个小成功（one small success after another），从而建立自信。A选项“逐步暴露于恐惧情境有助于建立信心”完美契合。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 3
question: According to the passage, the relationship between fear and creativity is that ______.
options: fear only affects people who have never been creative before
creative people are less likely to experience fear
fear cannot be reduced through one's creative work
overcoming fear can unlock people's creativity
explain: 参考答案:D 推理判断题。题目问的是恐惧与创造力之间的关系。文章第三段提到，为了帮助人们重新发现创造力自信（rediscover their creative confidence），需要给他们策略去克服阻碍我们的四种恐惧（get past four fears）。并且 Bandura 的实验也证明，克服恐惧能带来更广泛的自信，从而尝试新事物（即创造力的表现）。因此，克服恐惧能释放创造力。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 3
question: Which of the following is the best title for the passage?
options: Conquering Deep Fears in Our Lives
explain: 参考答案:C 主旨大意题。文章第一段指出人们天生具有创造力，但常因社会化而被压抑；第二段强调创造力的重要性；第三段点明主旨：我们的工作不是教创造力，而是帮助人们重新发现创造力自信（rediscover their creative confidence）；最后用 Bandura 的例子说明如何通过克服恐惧来找回自信。因此，C项“重拾你的创造力自信”最能概括全文。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 4
passage:
Why do we yawn(打哈欠)? This strange thing people do when they feel tired or bored is actually something mysterious. Yawning can be unbelievably easy to "catch"—when you see other people yawning, you may often find yourself wanting to yawn, too. Even reading about yawning can make you yawn.
Andrew Gallup, who works at State University of New York Polytechnic Institute in the US is a yawn expert. According to him, a natural yawn has nothing to do with raising oxygen levels. Instead, it may help increase alertness(警觉) and seems to be caused by rises in brain temperature.
Contagious(传染的) yawns are different. One study from Baylor University in the US suggested that catching a yawn is all about empathy—the ability to feel the emotions of others. The study showed that people who struggle to empathize with others are less likely to find a yawn contagious.
(76) It's not just humans who yawn, though. Scientists have also studied the behavior in animals. A study of lions in South Africa found that after yawning, lions would move with each other in time. This shows that an open mouth could be a way for the big cats to feel each other's feelings, which is particularly important for highly social animals such as lions.
Gallup says that yawning might have developed to keep groups of humans safe. By imitating each other, people may actually increase the awareness of a group as a whole when they yawn. A person's opening mouth wide signals that he is not feeling alert. Seeing that person yawning might therefore cause an observer to pay more attention. As the yawns spread, they would increase the group's awareness of danger.
Gallup conducted a study to test this theory. He showed a number of people pictures of snakes which are seen as a threat, and frogs which are not, before and after they had watched a video of others yawning. While watching the video didn't affect their ability to spot the non-threatening frogs, they were much better at spotting the threatening snakes after watching others yawn.
question: According to Andrew Gallup, a natural yawn may help______.
explain: 参考答案:D 细节理解题。题目问的是“根据 Andrew Gallup 的说法，一个自然的哈欠可能有助于什么？”定位到第二段："According to him, a natural yawn has nothing to do with raising oxygen levels. Instead, it may help increase alertness..." 这句话明确指出，自然哈欠与提高氧气水平无关，而是可能有助于提高警觉性（increase alertness）。C项“提高大脑温度”是因果倒置，原文是由大脑温度升高引起。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 4
question: According to the study from Baylor University, people who______are less likely to catch a contagious yawn.
options: have difficulty feeling the emotions of others
explain: 参考答案:A 细节理解题。题目要求根据贝勒大学的研究，判断哪类人不太容易“传染”打哈欠。定位到第三段："The study showed that people who struggle to empathize with others are less likely to find a yawn contagious." 句意表明，难以共情（struggle to empathize）的人，不太容易被哈欠传染。A项“难以感受他人情绪”符合句意。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 4
question: According to Paragraph 5, yawning spreading through a group may______.
options: increase the awareness of the group
signal a need for rest or sleep
explain: 参考答案:B 细节理解题。题目要求根据第五段内容判断“打哈欠在群体中传播”可能带来的作用。定位到第五段："By imitating each other, people may actually increase the awareness of a group as a whole when they yawn... As the yawns spread, they would increase the group's awareness of danger." 核心结论是传染性哈欠的作用是“提高群体对危险的警觉/意识”，对应B项。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 4
question: Gallup's research shows that people______after watching others yawn.
options: became eager to communicate with others
explain: 参考答案:C 细节理解题。题目问的是“Gallup 的研究表明，人们在看到别人打哈欠之后会怎样？”定位到最后一段："...they were much better at spotting the threatening snakes after watching others yawn." 实验结果显示，观看打哈欠视频后，受试者识别威胁性目标（蛇）的能力显著提高，即“更善于发现危险”，对应C项。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 4
question: Which of the following is probably the best title for the passage?
explain: 参考答案:B 主旨大意题。文章首段提出“为什么我们会打哈欠”的疑问，接着介绍了 Andrew Gallup 关于自然哈欠的研究、贝勒大学关于共情与传染性哈欠的研究、动物界的哈欠行为，以及 Gallup 关于群体警觉性的实验。全文围绕“打哈欠”展开，从人类到动物，从生理机制到社会功能，核心在于科学研究对打哈欠现象的探索和解释。因此，B项“Studies on Yawning”最能概括全文主旨。

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 5
passage:
Tourism wasn't always a problem in Barcelona(巴塞罗那). For years, the capital of Spain's northeastern Catalonia region welcomed a steady and lasting flow of visitors who came to appreciate its beautiful architecture and Mediterranean(地中海的) lifestyle.
Then came the 1992 Barcelona Summer Olympics. In the lead-up to the Games, a new urban program cleared railroad tracks and businesses along the Mediterranean coastline, allowing the Olympics to show the historic city's style and culture.
By 2004, Barcelona, a city of 1.5 million residents, hosted 4.5 million overnight tourists. The resulting crowds in places like La Rambla and its nearby neighborhoods caused some anger among locals.
"We feel completely invaded(侵略)," Joan Albert Riu, a lifelong Barcelona resident, told the reporter.
One major crowding hotspot, according to the mayor of Barcelona, is the area around the famous Sagrada Familia Basilica. (77) The neighborhood is home to 50,000 residents, but during summer, an additional 50,000 tourists may visit daily just to see the still-unfinished church.
(78) "We believe tourist demand is unstoppable," the mayor told the reporter. "Everyone is welcome, but there's a limit," he said, without giving a specific number. "The only solution is to control supply."
To make more room for the increasing number of visitors, the city has removed benches and small gardens near Sagrada Familia Basilica, where a new tower is set for completion later this year. To reduce the dense crowd, tour bus and taxi stops have been moved farther from the entrance.
There are also complaints about the further development of Barcelona's airport, which handled a record of 55 million passengers in 2024. The airport offers direct flights to around 200 global destinations, 70% of them in Europe, including eight U.S. cities.
The Spanish government and Catalan officials are discussing "how to increase capacity while protecting the surrounding environment," the Catalan president's press office told the reporter.
question: What is the main problem discussed in the passage?
options: The unfinished construction of Sagrada Familia Basilica.
The slow urban development of Spain.
The negative impact of too much tourism on Barcelona.
The environmental risks of airport redevelopment.

title: 2025年阅读 Passage 6
passage:
An 80-year-old grandmother Spillman from New Orleans wanted to contest for a chance to host a TV program. (79) On the contest stage, she showed her gentle grace. "I love everyone in the cast," she told the interviewer Henry when asked why she entered. "I watch it every Saturday night, and I thought, as I'm 80 years old, I want to inspire other seniors around the world to feel the same joy I do when I watch it."
Her son, Otis, told the press he was worried that hosting would be too much for her. However, her daughter, Mary Jane, disagreed. (80) "She's in good health and high spirits. And she's braver than I am."
Spillman's victory was no surprise to the other contestants, according to Connie Crawford, one of the five finalists. "We all knew she was going to win," Crawford, now a professor of acting and directing at Brown University, recalled to the reporter. "How could she not? She was so sweet, she was so lovable and there was no way anyone else was going to win."
Crawford said she's never watched the episode(电视片段) in which she made brief appearances. She wants to keep the memory unspoiled and remember instead "the way it felt". Among her treasured memories of the experience is meeting Spillman.
"She was just a shining gem(宝石) to everybody because she was clearly having fun, a great sport, smiling," she said. "Obviously, she was old, and people were kind of taking care of her. But you could just tell that people loved having her there. They couldn't have been nicer."
Spillman travelled to New York City, accompanied by her 23-year-old granddaughter, Janine Baker, who joined her on the stage, when Spillman celebrated the experience. "I want to thank everyone in the world for voting for me. I've had the most wonderful time I've ever had in my life," she said.
question: What is the main idea of this passage?
options: A journey to becoming a TV program hostess.
An experience of hosting a TV program.
The preparation for hosting a TV show.
The challenge of being a contestant on a TV show.

title: 2024年阅读 Passage 1
passage:
They won't get you drunk, but some experts say low-alcohol and alcohol-free beer drinks shouldn't be sold to minors, and they're calling for laws to prevent sales to kids and teens.
Surveys of primary, middle, and high school students in Japan, where the legal drinking age is 20, found that 20% to 30% said they were drinking non-alcoholic beverages(饮品). Additional studies in Japan found that primary school students who said they drank non-alcoholic drinks were more interested in drinking alcohol than those who said they didn't have these kinds of drinks.
In Australia, where the legal drinking age is 18, researchers conducted focus groups and surveyed teens aged 15 to 17 about the use of what they called zero-alcohol drinks. (76) They found that more than a third had tried zero-alcohol drinks, and that more than 1 in 5 were drinking them at least monthly. In the survey, teens who said they had tried zero-alcohol drinks were 2.5 times more likely to also have drunk alcohol compared with those who'd never had them.
Dr. Leon Booth said teens appear to be drinking these for various reasons. Some were just curious about new products and tried them but didn't drink them frequently. Others, though, said they had used zero-alcohol drinks to fit in with older friends who were drinking. "They are effectively role-playing drinking when they choose a zero-alcohol version(类型) of an alcoholic product, instead of a regular soft drink or something else obviously not alcoholic," Booth wrote in an email.
"In the focus group discussions, a few teens mentioned they had gotten used to the taste of beer by drinking zero-alcohol versions, which suggests that zero-alcohol beverages can help them to adjust to the taste of alcoholic beer," he added.
The Distilled Spirits Council said, "Our members agree that non-alcoholic beverages that are made to look like the real thing shouldn't be consumed by kids and teens."

title: 2024年阅读 Passage 2
passage:
During its glorious product announcement event on Tuesday, Apple introduced a new role of its latest AirPods Pro 2: hearing aid.
"We're adding this groundbreaking capability to help more than one billion people living with mild to moderate hearing loss," said Sumbul Ahmad Desai, Apple's vice president of health.
Apple said its hearing aid feature will boost frequencies(提高频率)—"so sounds are clearer to your ears." The company also said the feature will use "machine learning to make real-time adjustments as you go about your day."
On Thursday, the US Food and Drug Administration(FDA) approved Apple's hearing aid feature. Apple said the feature would become available to AirPods Pro 2 owners this fall through a software update in over 100 countries.
(77) Prescription(处方) hearing aids can cost thousands of dollars. At $249, Apple's AirPods Pro 2 may be significantly cheaper and more available for those who have suffered hearing loss—but they won't work for everyone. Here's what you need to know: To enjoy the new hearing aid feature, AirPods Pro 2 users will have to take a test that will analyze their hearing loss by playing a series of tones.
"After you take a hearing test, your AirPods Pro 2 are transformed into a personalized hearing aid, boosting specific sounds you need in real-time, like parts of speech or elements within your environment," said Desai.
But over-the-counter(非处方的) hearing aids like these aren't always the solution for hearing loss. FDA still requires people under 18 years old to purchase hearing aids by prescription. Over-the-counter hearing aids, such as Apple's offering, are also not a treatment for severe hearing loss, according to FDA. (78) Those with significant hearing loss should still go to see a doctor.
"Today's marketing authorization of an over-the-counter hearing aid software on a widely used consumer product is another step that advances the availability and acceptability of hearing support for adults with perceived mild to moderate hearing loss," said Michelle Tarver in a statement on Thursday.
question: AirPods Pro 2 can solve problems for ______.
options: all those who have hearing loss
people who have serious hearing loss
those who have mild or moderate hearing loss
people under the age of 18 who have mild hearing loss
explain: 参考答案:C 细节理解题。题目问的是“AirPods Pro 2 能为哪些人解决听力问题”。定位到第二段，苹果高管明确表示该功能是为了帮助“mild to moderate hearing loss”（轻度至中度听力损失）的人群。第七段又排除了严重听力损失者（severe hearing loss）和18岁以下人群，因此选C。

title: 2024年阅读 Passage 2

title: 2024年阅读 Passage 3
passage:
Kenna Ofoegbu, a software engineer in Houston, Texas, struggles to keep his three children cool in the summer, relying on air conditioning. (79) However, their home has lost power three times in the past two and a half months, with one outage(断电) lasting three days. This forced Kenna and his wife to pay for two nights at a hotel for air conditioning and the Internet, which he considered essential for his work.
After their experience, the couple purchased a generator for $1,500, along with $800 for installation. While generators are effective, they burn oils, leading to air pollution and contributing to climate change. As a result, many people, including Ofoegbu, are exploring cleaner energy options for emergencies.
Currently, many homeowners are installing battery(蓄电池) systems alongside solar panels(太阳能板). In California, over half of solar panel buyers have turned to battery storage to ensure power during outages. Nationally, sales of solar-plus-battery systems rose significantly over the past year, with experts predicting that 27% of new home solar systems will include battery storage. Although these systems can be expensive, falling prices and government efforts are making them more affordable.
Solar generators and solar power stations are also gaining popularity. These devices store electricity for future use, and one such product, the "Patriot Generator", costs around $2,500. (80) It can power a refrigerator for 19 hours or several electronic devices for over 100 hours. Companies like Yeti, Bluetti, and Jackery sell similar products, which weigh about 40 to 60 pounds and can be charged by plugging them in or using solar panels.
As climate change causes more severe weather, the need for backup(备份的) power solutions is increasing. In 2022, Americans experienced 6% more power disruptions than in 2013. On average, it took one hour longer to restore power compared to previous years. Many outages last over 12 hours, contributing to poor air quality as people rely on generators.
Oil generators emit harmful pollutants, which worsen health problems and contribute to climate change. Jason Benedict, who moved to Michigan and faced multiple outages, chose a cleaner solution by investing about $25,000 in solar panels and a Tesla Powerwall battery for his home.
Though traditional generators are less expensive, experts suggest they are not environment-friendly for the future. Kenna and Jason's choices reflect a growing trend toward green energy solutions in light of modern challenges.

title: 2024年阅读 Passage 4
passage:
Antarctica(南极洲) is the 5th largest continent(大陆). It covers approximately 5.5 million square miles; however, the actual size of the continent varies from month to month. It varies because the ice edge of the continent is always changing. The land itself is 98% covered by the Antarctic Ice Sheet, which is an average of 1.6 miles thick and holds about 90% of the fresh water on Earth.
Antarctica is divided into two parts by the mountains. These mountains run between the Ross Sea and the Weddell Sea and separate east from west. East Antarctica is higher in elevation(高度). Here the ice and snow rises over 14,000 feet.
Antarctica has an average elevation of about 7,500 feet. The highest point, standing at 16,050 feet, is the peak of Vinson Massif in the Ellsworth Mountain range. In contrast, the lowest point currently known is the Bentley Subglacial Trench(海沟). It is 8,200 feet below sea level. (76) However, the trench is covered by more than 9,840 feet of ice and snow.
While it may seem like there would be no bodies of water in Antarctica, it is actually home to more than 70 lakes. All of these lakes are covered by thousands of feet of ice. Lake Vostok is the largest of the lakes. It was discovered in 1996, beneath Russia's Vostok Station.
Antarctica currently receives groups of scientists who study the special environment there. The only other people who visit Antarctica arrive on some special ships. Since the 1960s, an ever increasing number of people have decided that the ideal vacation includes a tour of the Southern Ocean, with landings at some Antarctic islands extending from the continent.
Antarctica has no permanent residents and, unlike all other continents, it has no native population. (77) In fact, no one is known to have set eyes on Antarctica until 1820.

options: Half of the continent contains fresh water.

The continent does not have any lakes.
explain: 参考答案:B 细节理解题。题目要求判断四个选项中哪一项关于南极洲的描述是正确的。定位到第一段："The land itself is 98% covered by the Antarctic Ice Sheet..." 表明几乎整个陆地都被冰盖覆盖，B项正确。A项错在储存了地球约90%的淡水，不是“半个大陆含有淡水”；C项错在面积是550万平方英里，1.6是冰层厚度；第四段明确说有70多个湖泊，D项错误。

question: The mountains on Antarctica ______.
options: separate the eastern part from the western one
explain: 参考答案:A 细节理解题。题目问关于南极洲山脉的描述。定位到第二段："Antarctica is divided into two parts by the mountains. These mountains run between the Ross Sea and the Weddell Sea and separate east from west." 明确指出山脉将东部与西部分开，A项正确。

title: 2024年阅读 Passage 4
question: Which of the following about Vinson Massif is TRUE?
options: It is the lowest point on Antarctica.
It is the highest point on Antarctica.
explain: 参考答案:B 细节理解题。定位到第三段："The highest point, standing at 16,050 feet, is the peak of Vinson Massif..." 明确指出 Vinson Massif 的峰顶是南极洲的最高点，B项正确。

title: 2024年阅读 Passage 4
question: The word "it" in Paragraph 4 refers to ______.
explain: 参考答案:C 指代题。定位到第四段首句："While it may seem like there would be no bodies of water in Antarctica, it is actually home to more than 70 lakes." 前半句让步状语从句的核心论述对象是 Antarctica，后半句与前文构成转折关系，承接前文的论述对象展开表述，因此此处代词 it 指代的是 Antarctica。

title: 2024年阅读 Passage 4
question: According to Paragraph 5, ______.
options: more and more people have been to Antarctica for different purposes
scientists have found a small number of native residents on Antarctica
some people have become permanent residents on Antarctica
many people go to visit Antarctica by air
